scopes.description: Any of send, read, devices, webhooks. Defaults to all.

key.description: The full key. It is shown once and never stored.

events.description: Any of message.received, message.sent, message.delivered, message.failed, message.unknown, device.online, device.offline, ping.

clear_preferred_sim.description: Set true to fall back to the phone's default SIM.

enabled.description: A disabled phone receives no new sends, and sends already queued for it fail.

preferred_sim_subscription_id.description: SIM to send from when a send names none.

receive_enabled.description: Forward incoming SMS from this phone.

send_delay_seconds.description: Pause between consecutive sends on the phone.

clear_preferred_sim.description: Set true to fall back to the phone's default SIM.

enabled.description: A disabled phone receives no new sends.

preferred_sim_subscription_id.description: SIM to send from when a send names none.

receive_enabled.description: Forward incoming SMS from this phone.

field.description: Location of the problem, for example body.to[0].

sims.description: Array of SIM descriptors with subscription_id, carrier, slot, country.

telemetry.description: Battery, network, storage, uptime, timezone, locale. Free-form object.

body.description: The text, with concatenated parts already joined.

fingerprint.description: Hash of sender, body, and timestamp computed on the phone. Repeats are ignored.

inserted.description: False when this message was already stored.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to get the next page. Absent on the last page.

hardware_key.description: Stable hash the app derives from the handset, so re-pairing finds the same device.

device_token.description: Bearer token for /v1/device endpoints. Shown once.

code.description: Type this into the app, or scan pair_url as a QR code.

id.description: Poll GET /v1/devices/pairing-codes/{id} to learn when a phone has used the code.

pair_url.description: Deep link the app understands. Encode it as a QR code.

consumed.description: True once a phone has paired with this code.

device.description: The phone that used the code, once one has.

email.description: Sign-in email. A verification code is sent to it.

body.description: Message text. Long texts are sent as concatenated SMS.

device_id.description: Phone to send from. Defaults to the account's default device, else the most recently online one.

scheduled_at.description: Send later, up to 7 days ahead.

sim_subscription_id.description: SIM to use on a multi-SIM phone. Unknown ids fall back to the phone's preferred SIM.

to.description: Recipient phone numbers, ideally E.164 such as +14155550123.

message_ids.description: One id per recipient, in the order given after de-duplication.

at.description: When it happened on the phone. Defaults to now.

secret.description: Signing secret, shown once. Verify X-Simhook-Signature with it.

apiKey.description: Developer API key from the dashboard.
apiKey.name: X-Api-Key

deviceToken.description: Device token issued at pairing. Only valid on /v1/device endpoints.

info.description: Send and receive SMS through your own Android phone. Authenticate with an API key in the X-Api-Key header.
info.title: simhook API

post.description: The full key is returned once. Only its hash is stored.
Stops the key working immediately while keeping its record.
Checks the password and sets the session cookie used by the dashboard.

get.description: The account behind the credentials, with its plan limits and usage this period.

post.description: Completes a reset. Every existing session is signed out.
post.summary: Set a new password with a reset code

post.description: Emails a code if the address has an account. The response is the same either way.
Creates the account, signs it in with a session cookie, and emails a verification code. Sending is blocked until the email is verified.

get.description: Every send on the account, newest first, with per-status counts.
The batch plus one message per recipient. Poll this to follow a send.

delete.description: Removes this phone from the account and revokes its token. Message history is kept.

post.description: Reports the phone is alive and uploads its state. The response carries the settings the phone should apply.
Stores an incoming message and fans out message.received. Returns 201 when stored, 200 when it was already known.
Idempotent. Out-of-order reports never move a message backwards.

get.description: The messages this phone should send now, oldest first. Fetching marks them dispatched. A message stays in the list until the phone reports its outcome, so a phone that lost one gets it again.

parameters.description: At most this many messages. Default 100.
parameters.name: limit

schema.description: At most this many messages. Default 100.

post.description: Exchanges a pairing code for a device record and a device token. Called by the phone app.

get.description: Every phone paired with the account, default first.

post.description: Mints a code valid for 10 minutes. Enter it in the phone app, or show pair_url as a QR code for the app to scan.

get.description: Whether a phone has used the code yet, and which one. Poll it while showing the code.

delete.description: Revokes the phone's token and stops sends to it. Message history is kept.

patch.description: Only the fields you send change. The phone is told at once and reloads its settings within seconds; a phone that is offline picks them up when it is back.

post.description: Sends that omit device_id go out from the default device.

get.description: Sent and received messages across the account, newest first, with delivery state on each. To poll for new messages, request order=asc with a from bound and follow next_cursor.

parameters.description: Comma-separated device ids. Default: all paired devices.
parameters.name: device_ids

schema.description: Comma-separated device ids. Default: all paired devices.

parameters.description: Match against text, recipient, and sender.
parameters.name: q

schema.description: Match against text, recipient, and sender.

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at, RFC 3339.
parameters.name: from

schema.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at, RFC 3339.

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on created_at, RFC 3339.
parameters.name: to

schema.description: Exclusive upper bound on created_at, RFC 3339.

parameters.description: desc (default) for newest first; asc to walk forward when polling.
parameters.name: order

schema.description: desc (default) for newest first; asc to walk forward when polling.

post.description: Queues one text to one or more recipients from a phone on the account. Acceptance is not delivery: follow the batch or subscribe to webhooks for the outcome. Every recipient counts as one message against the plan.

get.description: The public plan catalogue with limits and prices. No credentials needed.

post.description: Subscribes an https URL to events. Each delivery is a JSON POST signed with the returned secret: X-Simhook-Signature is t=<unix>,v1=<hex hmac-sha256 of "<t>.<body>">. Respond 2xx within 30 seconds; other responses are retried for about two days.

get.description: Delivery attempts across every webhook on the account, newest first, including webhooks since deleted.

post.description: Deliveries queued from now on are signed with the new secret.
Queues a ping delivery so you can check your endpoint and signature verification.
